item.title: 'Malignant clown': Republican lawmaker faces backlash after saying Muslims don't belong in US
item.description: Lawmaker Andy Ogles claims US Muslims should move to Muslim countries if they want to practice their faith.

item.title: Iran's foreign minister rules out negotiations with US after 'very bitter experience'
item.description: Araghchi states that any renewed talks are not on the table after the US attacked Iran despite 'big progress' in February's Geneva summits.

item.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they 'will determine end of war'
item.description: Statement comes after Trump says Iran war could end soon, as Revolutionary Guards accuse Trump of spreading "false claims" about Iran's military.

item.title: Israel kills Lebanese Maronite Catholic priest in southern Christian village
item.description: Pierre al-Rahi killed from injuries sustained in Israeli attack while helping wounded neighbours.

item.title: Islamophobic content against American Muslims spikes online amid US-Israeli war on Iran: study
item.description: The study finds that many posts used dehumanising language describing Muslims as “rats,” “vermin” and “parasites,” with others call for deportations, internment camps or mosque attacks.

item.title: UK backs global oil reserve release as war on Iran drags on
item.description: Chancellor Rachel Reeves says Britain would support an emergency release of stockpiles by the International Energy Agency after Iran effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz, warning the disruption could drive inflation higher.

item.title: US says Afghanistan designated as 'state sponsor of wrongful detention'
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says it is not safe for Americans to travel to Afghanistan because the interim Afghan Taliban government continues to unjustly detain US citizens and other foreign nationals.

item.title: Pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil’s supporters rally at Columbia one year after his detention
item.description: Khalil accuses the university of enabling the crackdown on pro-Palestine activism.

item.title: US investigators search Epstein's New Mexico ranch over abuse claims
item.description: Authorities aim to uncover evidence at Zorro ranch linked to Epstein’s alleged crimes against women and minors.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 10 March
item.description: Iran's top diplomat Araghchi says Tehran will not return to the table with the US after recent military strikes. And, Russian and US presidents hold their first direct talks since December to address the ongoing war against Iran and Ukraine conflict.
